lede: Interior Secretary Douglas J. Burgum disclosed six new trades dated April 8, 2026, the largest a purchase of Nucleus Security, Inc. through Arthur Ventures Growth IV, LP valued at $100,001 to $250,000. The remaining transactions, all tied to Arthur Ventures funds, included additional purchases and sales of $1,001 to $15,000 in holdings such as zizzl Health, Hudu Technologies, Inc. and Decimal Technologies, Inc. Across all filings tracked by Open Cabinet, Burgum has reported 149 transactions, of which 104 were flagged as filed late under the filer's own certification.
